# GitHub routing library

Unmodified modules from [Sma-Das/multi-github-account](https://github.com/Sma-Das/multi-github-account) at commit `16370c37489fa293f46bad6570d3ca660fed7c8d`. MIT license included. AccountDeck calls these modules for accounts, routes, scans, and paired computers. They share the existing ghr configuration and GitHub CLI credential store.
